name: smwgraphics-kirby-s-halloween-adventure-graveyard
title: Kirby's Halloween Adventure - Graveyard
description:
A rip of the graveyard tileset from Kirby's Halloween Adventure, a hack for Kirby's Adventure made by Kirb-Star. Please credit them if you use this.

This tileset makes heavy usage of the pure black colour in the palette for a background. Only the canopy and bubbles are transparent. So for most of your level you will have the pure black block sitting behind every other tile.

I edited some new tiles so canopy edge blends better, and made different versions of the ground slope that can be used with any height of the background grass.
